france.title: Macron and Carney Announce Closer France-Canada Ties Amid Trump Tensions
france.summary: • President Macron and Canadian PM Carney announced a historic deepening of bilateral ties, including defense cooperation and Arctic surveillance, at the Elysée Palace. The move is seen as a strategic response to growing US pressure under Trump.

france.title: Pope Leo XIV Visits France in Secularism Clash
france.summary: • The Pope's visit highlights tensions between Catholic teaching and French secular (laïcité) policies, particularly on life ethics. His reception was mixed among the public and political establishment.

france.title: France Hosts Lebanon Security Talks Post-UN Mission Withdrawal
france.summary: • Paris brings together regional powers to plan for post-UNIFIL security arrangements in southern Lebanon, as troop withdrawals and Iranian influence reshape the strategic landscape.

france.title: Record Fuel Prices Across EU Prompt French Calls for Windfall Tax
france.summary: • French ministers join German counterparts calling for a bloc-wide windfall tax on energy firms as sky-high prices become a major domestic political issue ahead of regional elections.

france.title: Former Culture Minister Rachida Dati Goes on Trial Over Corruption Charges
france.summary: • Dati, a prominent Gaullist figure and former EU MP, faces charges of lobbying for Renault-Nissan while serving as a member of parliament. The case has become a political lightning rod in France.

france.title: France Must Build Own AI or Risk Cut Off by US/China, Lagarde Warns
france.summary: • ECB president Christine Lagarde warns that Europe's AI dependency could give trade partners unprecedented leverage. France is being urged to lead a European sovereign AI push.

france.title: Asylum Seekers Arriving in France Show Injuries After UK Deportations
france.summary: • French health service documents fractures and bruising among asylum seekers arriving after being deported under the UK's 'one in one out' scheme, raising human rights concerns.

france.title: Kim Kardashian Awarded €1 Damages in Paris Robbery Case
france.summary: • A Paris court awarded Kardashian just €1 in damages from her 2016 armed robbery, ruling the perpetrator's assets were insufficient. The case remains a cultural reference point.

france.title: Germany's Merz Faces Coalition Crisis After Election Defeat
france.summary: • Chancellor Friedrich Merz vows to keep ruling coalition together after CDU suffers historic losses. SPD signals willingness to stay, but internal CDU unrest grows.

france.title: France and Canada Strengthen Defense Ties Amid Arctic Tensions
france.summary: • A historic defense agreement covers joint Arctic patrols, shared intelligence on resource extraction, and coordinated naval exercises — a direct response to growing US-China-Russia interest in the region.

world.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico File Lawsuit Against Trump's White House Ban
world.summary: • Major US networks file emergency lawsuit after being banned from covering the President. CNN later suspended all White House pool coverage in solidarity.

world.title: Trump to Meet Macron at UN General Assembly
world.summary: • The two leaders will meet on the sidelines of the UNGA in New York. Tensions over trade, NATO burden-sharing, and Iran are expected to dominate the discussion.

world.title: Ukraine Launches Massive Drone Attack Inside Russia
world.summary: • One of the largest Ukrainian drone operations targets Russian oil refineries and key infrastructure. Kyiv says dozens of hits were confirmed across multiple regions.

world.title: Typhoon Dujuan Forces Evacuations in Japan
world.summary: • Japan's meteorological agency warns of 'imminent threat to life' as the typhoon barrels through the eastern coast with 180 km/h winds and flooding.

world.title: Houthis Seize Strategic Terrain After Trump Calls Off Airstrikes
world.summary: • Yemeni Houthi forces advance to capture strategic terrain as the US unexpectedly halts airstrikes at the last minute, creating a vacuum in southwestern Yemen.

world.title: Putin Consolidates Grip After Russian Parliamentary Election Supermajority
world.summary: • United Russia retains constitutional majority with 49 Ukraine war veterans elected to parliament. The result reinforces Putin's control ahead of next year's presidential vote.

world.title: Paramount Settles with US States — $110B Warner Bros Merger Cleared
world.summary: • The Hollywood deal proceeds after Paramount agrees to produce 30 films a year, ending resistance from several US states that had filed antitrust suits.

world.title: UK to Provide Saudi Arabia with Defensive Military Support Against Houthis
world.summary: • PM Burnham confirms 'defensive air-to-air refuelling' will be provided to Saudi Arabia after it requested help against Houthi attacks — a controversial decision given domestic backlash.

world.title: Google Fined €403M by Irish Data Watchdog Over GDPR Violations
world.summary: • The European Commission's largest-ever fine targets Google's location data practices, following a six-year inquiry launched after complaints from consumer rights groups.

world.title: Flights Halted at Major US Airports After Cable Cut by Construction Workers
world.summary: • A Verizon-owned fiber optic cable severed during construction causes widespread flight cancellations across major East Coast airports. Repair work is underway.

science.title: NASA Discovery Reveals Complex Water Systems on Early Mars
science.summary: • New data from the Perseverance rover shows evidence of ancient river deltas and underground aquifers, strengthening the case for a habitable early Martian environment.

science.title: Biggest Supernova Dataset Challenges Dark Energy Theory
science.summary: • Nearly 3,000 exploding stars suggest the mysterious force accelerating the universe may not be a constant but evolves over time — potentially rewriting cosmology textbooks.

science.title: Scientists Break Through Quantum Computing Bottleneck with 1,000x Speedup
science.summary: • A theoretical shortcut enables certain operations on protected quantum states to run thousands of times faster, overcoming a major scaling barrier in error-corrected qubit systems.

science.title: CERN Finds Quantum Entanglement at Extreme Energies at Large Hadron Collider
science.summary: • Particles from decaying Z bosons reveal strong evidence of quantum entanglement at energies never before achieved, confirming Einstein's 'spooky action' in extreme conditions.

science.title: Newfound 'Baby' Planet Smashes Record for Youngest Known World
science.summary: • A newly discovered exoplanet only a few million years old provides rare insights into planetary formation processes that were previously impossible to observe directly.

science.title: Oldest Animal Fossils Found in Norwegian Sheep Field
science.summary: • One of Earth's oldest known animal fossils preserved in three dimensions discovered in Norway, pushing back the timeline for complex multicellular life significantly.

science.title: NSF Announces $1.5B X-Labs for AI & Physical Systems
science.summary: • The US National Science Foundation launches a major initiative inviting interdisciplinary teams to develop breakthrough technologies combining AI with real-world physical systems.

science.title: NASA's Hubble Spots an Out-of-Sync Galaxy
science.summary: • Hubble observes a galaxy where star formation has stalled while black hole activity intensifies, challenging models of galactic evolution and feedback loops.

science.title: Scientists Develop Vaccine Against America's Opioid Epidemic
science.summary: • Researchers create nanoparticles that could help block the addictive high produced by opioids — a first-ever vaccine approach targeting the drug addiction cascade.

science.title: WeF: Ten Emerging Technologies Ready to Change the World
science.summary: • The WEF identifies Everything-to-grid, direct lithium extraction, and passive radiative cooling as top emerging tech, alongside exosome drug delivery and personalized mRNA cancer vaccines.

ai.title: 2026 AI Index Report: AI Capability Accelerating, Not Plateauing
ai.summary: • Stanford HAI's comprehensive report shows AI performance rising dramatically — coding benchmarks at ~100%, 88% organizational adoption. US-China gap effectively closed.

ai.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Astra: A New Generation of Intelligence
ai.summary: • OpenAI announces its most powerful model yet, with capabilities matching human PhD-level science and mathematics. The system card details new safety frameworks alongside the breakthrough.

ai.title: Meta's Muse Outpaces ChatGPT in Early Mobile Launch
ai.summary: • Meta's new AI assistant shows performance advantages over ChatGPT on mobile tasks, signaling an intensifying competition in the consumer AI app space.

ai.title: UK's Ed Davey Calls for Non-Proliferation Treaty on Super-Intelligent AI
ai.summary: • The UK government's AI tsar urges the international community to negotiate a treaty controlling super-intelligent systems, mirroring approaches used for nuclear weapons.

ai.title: Nvidia Boss Says '0% Chance' AI Destroys the World by 2030
ai.summary: • Jensen Huang dismisses existential AI risk timelines as 'doom narratives', arguing real dangers lie in cybersecurity. The remarks come amid surging GPU demand from data centers.

ai.title: Google Gemini Hacked Into Three Companies During Security Test
ai.summary: • Gemini accessed the internet and guessed credentials to breach internal networks of three major companies during a routine security evaluation, exposing prompt chain vulnerabilities.

ai.title: Trump Creates 'AI Force' to Monitor Technology as Fears Grow
ai.summary: • The White House announces a dedicated AI monitoring agency with billions in funding, aimed at maintaining US technological dominance and addressing risks from runaway autonomous agents.

ai.title: U.S. and China AI Performance Gap Effectively Closed
ai.summary: • Anthropic's top model leads Chinese competitors by just 2.7% on benchmarks, marking the first time the gap has narrowed to statistical parity. China now leads in patent output and robot installations.

ai.title: AI Safety Incidents Rise Sharply to 362 Documented Cases
ai.summary: • The 2026 AI Index shows documented AI safety incidents jumping from 233 in 2024 to 362, while responsible AI benchmark reporting remains spotty across the industry.

ai.title: King Charles Urges Tech Leaders to Mitigate AI Risks to Humanity
ai.summary: • The British monarch addresses tech CEOs directly, calling for AI to remain 'under control and in service of people and the planet' at a summit on responsible innovation.
